mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation_type, client_id, request_fingerprint, original_operation_id, secret_record_id, outcome, http_status, completed_at FROM iam_oauth_client_management_operations WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actorIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation_type, client_id, request_fingerprint, original_operation_id, secret_record_id, outcome, http_status, completed_at FROM iam_oauth_client_management_operations WHERE original_operation_id = #{originalOperationId} AND operation_type = 'RECOVER' AND outcome = 'SUCCEEDED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_oauth_client_management_operations (id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation_type, client_id, request_fingerprint, original_operation_id, secret_record_id, outcome, http_status, completed_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.actorIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.operationType}, #{row.clientId}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.originalOperationId}, #{row.secretRecordId}, #{row.outcome}, #{row.httpStatus}, #{row.completedAt})
